rationale.edition: All 31 changed paths sit under web/src/ (components/alertLibrary, composables/alerts, types, views/AlertLibrary, and 16 locales/languages files). None are in enterprise-owned locations (no enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, or src/enterprise/ paths), and none of the enterprise keyword signals (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/sensitive-data/logo-management) appear in the changed paths or symbol names. The feature renders enterprise-gated anomaly-detection alerts, but that gating is runtime state (config.isEnterprise + zoConfig.anomaly_detection_enabled), not code path ownership, so by the path-based rule this is an OSS change.
rationale.skip: Not skipped: no explicit opt-out label or skip comment was passed, and the change is a user-facing UI change rather than docs/CI-only. The Alert Library gains new views, badges, drawer sections, and install-dialog steps, so it does not qualify as a no-behavior change.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted: the AlertLibrary view, LibraryCard, LibraryDrawer, and LibraryInstallDialog all gain user-exercisable behavior — anomaly cards with Anomaly/Enterprise badges, a locked-card upgrade dialog instead of the drawer, an anomaly-only install flow that skips the Tune step, mixed-batch installs routing each kind through its own create call, and enterprise gating (locked/hidden/enabled).
rationale.area: The bulk of the UI change lives in web/src/views/AlertLibrary and web/src/components/alertLibrary plus composables/alerts/useAlertLibrary, which maps to the Alerts product area. The existing alert-library.spec.js already lives under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Alerts, so the new spec belongs beside it.
rationale.group: Anomaly detection is enterprise-gated, so the new spec must run on the enterprise binary with anomaly_detection_enabled. The enterprise overlay ci_matrix.ent.json already defines an Alerts-Anomaly shard (actual_folder Alerts) running alerts-anomaly-detection.spec.js, which is the closest existing shard for enterprise-only anomaly alert library coverage rather than the shared OSS Alerts shard.
rationale.existing_tests: No Playwright E2E specs in the diff — the changed .spec.ts files under web/src/ are Vitest unit tests, not E2E coverage, so there are no existing E2E specs to extend or complement.
